articles.title: Trump announced a deal for Hamas to disarm. And, the U.S. economy slowed a bit - NPR
articles.description: President Trump says a deal has been reached for Hamas to completely disarm and Israeli forces to withdraw from Gaza. And, the U.S. economy slowed some, but Americans continued to spend.
